decision: Publisher-registered 2013 book chapter by Frieze and Loh; separate from the author-page edited Olympiad book.
Same title, author, and pages, but two registered DOIs identify a 2003 journal article and a 2006 book chapter. Derivation or reprint relationship is not asserted.
Author citation and older CV identify the 2013 conference and 2016 journal versions; CMU also lists the 2013 preprint. Retain all manifestations.
Author-linked arXiv ID and journal citation resolve the title expansion; journal and preprint remain separate manifestations.
CMU's 2026 date is an arXiv v4 display date; the captured arXiv result gives first submission 2020-11-08.
Publisher DOI fixes the journal article identity. Crossref gives 2015 online publication while the CMU card and CV use the 2016 volume; CV reverses the first two title words.
Seven-person bylines overlap, but titles, output types, and DOIs differ. Content-level relationship remains open.
Author page and older CV identify Loh as one of three editors of a 2005 Olympiad volume. Do not treat it as a research journal article.
